pkgmetadata.longdescription: sys-apps/systemd-utils 262 with every program and library replaced by systemd-utils-rs, a strict-compatibility Rust port: udevadm and udevd, systemd-hwdb, systemd-tmpfiles, systemd-sysctl, the udev helpers and libudev for each ABI. Rules, hwdb sources, man pages, headers and pkg-config files are upstream v262's, installed as sys-apps/systemd-utils-262 installs them.

use.flag: Install the udev daemon, udevadm, the helpers and libudev
